item.description: The minor party's support will be critical to pass a minimum tax on trusts and a carve-out for start-ups in the capital gains tax regime.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: Bunnings to make 230 jobs redundant and offshore some tech services
item.description: Hardware giant Bunnings will cut 230 jobs as it looks to offshore a section of its technology department.

item.title: ABC News: New baby cameras at Canberra Hospital's intensive care unit
item.description: New baby cameras have been installed at the Canberra Hospital's intensive and special care units, providing a 24-hour live stream to parents.

item.title: ABC News: Wallabies in danger of missing 'big three' target
item.description: The pressure is on the out-of-form Wallabies to beat Wales this weekend as they try to meet their goal of finishing top-three among Southern Hemisphere sides in the Nations Championship.

item.title: ABC News: Former Victorian fire chief received bullet during union dispute
item.description: A former fire chief is among two people who received bullets in the mail after locking horns with Victoria's United Firefighters Union, the ABC can reveal.

item.title: ABC News: Robert Pattinson eyes his biggest role yet as James Bond
item.description: Twilight shot Robert Pattinson to stardom. But who would have guessed that 20 years later the vampire hit would be correctly predicting the next 007?

item.title: ABC News: MP declares shares in data centre developer before calling for moratorium
item.description: A Tasmanian independent MP who has tabled a bill for a moratorium on new data centres has declared shares in a property giant whose global development pipeline is almost 80 per cent data centres.

item.title: ABC News: First responder 'in shock' after discovering triple fatality
item.description: When Courtney Wright arrived at the scene of a confronting crash in Western Australia's south, she knew she had to do something.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: Man charged with murder of two-week-old Hobart baby
item.description: A 23-year-old man has been arrested and charged with the murder of a 15-day-old baby, who died of "critical injuries" in hospital earlier this month.

item.title: ABC News: Government backflips on backpacker policy
item.description: Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke has increased the cap on third-year working holiday visas by 20,000 places after backlash from agriculture, tourism and hospitality sectors.

item.title: ABC News: Councillor at troubled Perth shire calls for sackings if dysfunction persists
item.description: A councillor at the troubled Shire of Serpentine-Jarrahdale suggests he and his fellow councillors should be sacked if the turmoil cannot be resolved soon.

item.title: ABC News: I'm celebrating my ostomy bag, even if it grosses others out
item.description: Funny looks aren't the worst of it, it's the disgusted faces that really get to me. But I don't speak out about this for myself alone.

item.title: ABC News: Qld government accepts 'urgent and pressing' CFMEU recommendations
item.description: The Queensland government has accepted both recommendations from a scathing report from the CFMEU commission of inquiry.

item.title: ABC News: Whistleblower David McBride criticises ADF top brass in first interview since prison
item.description: Former military lawyer David McBride has given his first interview since leaving a Canberra prison, where he served more than two years behind bars for leaking secret military documents to journalists.

item.title: ABC News: Businessman who offered NDIS client drugs guilty of $450k plot
item.description: Richard Kennedy ripped the NDIS off to the tune of $450,000. But his incriminating phone calls were only the start of his problems when police began investigating.

item.title: ABC News: Hospital worker charged with accessing child abuse material stood down
item.description: In an email seen by the ABC, hospital staff were told the allegations were being taken "very seriously" and that support would be provided, as the matter may "bring a range of emotions and responses".
